visual_action: The video is a split-screen. The top panel shows Kamala Harris speaking at a podium flanked by American flags. The bottom panel shows the back of a young girl with two long braids, looking up at what appears to be a stage. The video then cuts to a single black-and-white photograph of a young Kamala Harris smiling.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: An adult photo of her speaking at a podium and a childhood photo of her are the central images of the video.

on_screen_text.text: There wouldn't be this if there hadn't been...

spoken_summary: The audio is not spoken dialogue but a song with the lyrics, "There wouldn't be this if there hadn't been... you."
audio_music: A high-pitched, sped-up 'nightcore' style pop song plays throughout the video. The tone is sentimental and inspirational, corresponding to the visuals of looking back at one's younger self.
editing_pacing: Slideshow-style, with a single cut from a static split-screen image to another static photo.
cultural_references: The audio is a nightcore version of the Taylor Swift song 'thanK you aIMee'.
The 'nightcore' music style is an internet trend involving speeding up and raising the pitch of songs.
central_claim: Kamala Harris's current success and position of power are the direct result of her journey and experiences starting from when she was a young girl.
intended_effect: To humanize and generate inspiration, admiration, and pride for Kamala Harris by framing her career as a personal journey.
